slots.value: Summit Roofing Co. is a family-owned roofing company that has looked after Austin roofs since 2004.

A family business

Summit Roofing Co. is family-owned and has worked on Austin roofs since 2004. More than 2,000 roofs have been replaced by the crew in that time.

How we work

Every job starts with a free inspection. We photograph what we find, explain it plainly and put the estimate in writing before any work begins.

  • Repairs and full replacements
  • Storm damage and insurance claims
  • Free inspections
We explain what we find without jargon.
Every price is on paper before work starts.
We clear the yard before we leave.
We show you the options and let you decide.
We look at the whole roof and give you a written estimate.
Call us and ask anything about your roof before you book.
